info.metaTitle: About SnifferTrek – Features & how it works
info.metaDescription: SnifferTrek combines travel reports with a planner for routes, hotels, flights and rental cars. Compare and book your next trip.
info.ogDescription: Travel reports plus planner: route, hotels, flights and tips for your next tour.
info.heroSubtitle: Plan the route. Compare hotels. Find flights. Discover sights. All in one place – 100% free.
info.featuresSubtitle: From the first idea to the finished booking – SnifferTrek is with you at every step.
info.f1Text: Add stops, see distances and driving times – a clear route instead of tab chaos.
info.f2Text: Find stays along the route and compare prices across booking platforms.
info.f3Text: Check flight options for your dates and continue to the provider you choose.
info.f4Text: Discover POIs and add them to the trip – from must-sees to quieter corners.
info.f5Text: Compare offers at the destination – from compact cars to SUVs.
info.f6Text: Compare cover for the trip and continue directly with the provider.
info.f7Text: Discover routes and offers – from the Mediterranean and beyond.
info.f8Text: Find connections across Europe and continue booking tickets with ease.
info.f9Text: Stay online on the road – an eSIM for your destination, without expensive roaming.
info.s1Text: Enter start and destination, add stops and choose how you travel.
info.s2Text: Compare hotels, flights and rental cars from top providers. Find the best price.
info.s3Text: Book directly with the provider you choose. Everything organised in your travel guide.
info.s4Text: Create a PDF travel report with route, hotels and discoveries — to take along or share.
info.partnersSubtitle: Compare prices from hundreds of travel providers – so you always find the best deal.
info.w1Text: No more tab chaos. Route, hotels, flights and POIs in one overview.
info.w2Text: We compare dozens of providers so you never overpay.
info.w3Text: Your whole trip as a timeline – with booking status and notes.
info.w4Text: Plan on your computer, take everything on iPhone. Offline too.
info.ctaSubtitle: Start planning now – free and with no obligation.
info.ctaFine: Free · No sign-up needed · Start right away
